title: Wizard with Mystic Egg
description: A bearded wizard in ornate robes stands in a vibrant mountain village courtyard at sunset, conjuring swirling rings of golden magic around a large, intricately decorated mosaic egg that floats before him. The scene is filled with blooming roses in terracotta pots, ancient stone ruins with Nordic-style runes, and stone buildings set against dramatic snow-capped peaks under a fiery orange and purple sky.
prompt: A bearded wizard with outstretched hands stands in a sunlit mountain village courtyard at sunset, casting swirling rings of golden magical energy around a large ornate glowing egg covered in colorful mosaic patterns. Ancient stone walls with carved runes, abundant blooming roses in pots, stone houses, and dramatic snow-capped peaks in the background under a fiery orange and purple sky, highly detailed fantasy scene
